title: 5 Finger Pattern
description: Play each key slowly, pressing firmly to the bottom of the keybed. Keep your wrist relaxed and your fingers curved as if holding an apple. Play notes C- D- E- F- G forwards and backwards. Start with RH, then LH, then both.

title: Legato vs. Staccato
description: Play a simple five-note pattern using smooth connected notes (legato), then repeat using short detached notes (staccato).

title: Simple Song Practice
description: Practice a beginner song such as 'Mary Had a Little Lamb' or 'Hot Cross Buns.' Focus on steady rhythm, correct notes, and relaxed posture.

title: Dynamics Practice
description: Play the same short melody softly (piano), then loudly (forte). Listen carefully for the difference in volume while maintaining good technique.

title: C Major Scale
description: Practice the one-octave C Major scale slowly. Focus on correct fingering and smooth thumb crossings.

title: Quarter Note, 8th Note Rhythm
description: Pat and count steady quarter notes with your right hand, and pat the 8th notes with your left hand. Switch after 4 minuets, Use your metronome to stay on beat!

title: Finger Number Warm-Up
description: Practice lifting and playing each finger individually. Count finger numbers aloud as you play: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and back down.

title: Chord Switching
description: Alternate between the C Major and G Major chords without stopping. Keep your fingers close to the keys and aim for smooth, accurate changes.

title: Major vs. Minor Chords
description: Compare C Major (C-E-G) with C Minor (C-E♭-G). Listen carefully to how the mood changes between the two chords.

title: Chord Accompaniment Practice
description: Play a steady C, F, and G chord pattern while counting four beats for each chord. Imagine accompanying a simple melody while keeping a steady tempo.

title: Chord Hold Exercise
description: Play each major chord and hold it for eight counts. Focus on even pressure from every finger and a relaxed hand position.

title: I-IV-V Chord Progression
description: Practice moving between the C, F, and G Major chords. Play each chord four times before moving to the next. Focus on smooth transitions.

title: Hands Together Practice
description: Play both hands together using the C Major scale. Keep both hands moving at the same speed without rushing.
